info.title: GetYourGuide API
info.description:
Tour & activity listings from GetYourGuide — prices, ratings, availability dates and destinations, plus per-activity detail and bulk sitemap discovery.

Every request needs an API key in the `Authorization: Bearer <key>` header. Create one at https://maviapi.com/dashboard/keys. A successful request uses one credit, unless its operation says more (`x-credits`). That price covers 200 rows (or the operation's `x-credits-rows`); a request that returns more pays it again for each further page of that many rows. The `x-maviapi-credits` response header says what a request cost.

Endpoint reference with live examples: https://maviapi.com/apis/getyourguide

get.summary: All activities for a location (every page)
get.description:
Every tour & activity GetYourGuide lists for a location slug (e.g. venice-l35), all pages: price, rating, review count, duration, next availability, image. pagination.total matches the site's own count.

Each successful request uses 10 credits for every 24 rows it returns (at least 10 credits).

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: GetYourGuide place slug in the {city}-l{id} form (from /catalog or an activity URL).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max activities per page (default 50, max 1000). Every page of the location is fetched once and cached, so any limit/offset is served from the same full list.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Activities to skip. Works up to pagination.total (the site's full count), not just the first page.

total.description: The site's own count of activities for the location

complete.description: True when every activity the site counts was collected (false only if a very large location ran out of time; the list is then a subset)

title.example: Venice: Marco Polo Airport Water Taxi Transfer

abstract.example: Make your arrival in Venice unforgettable with a water taxi transfer to your hotel or the nearest accessible point from Venice Airport.
abstract.description: Short summary shown on the listing card

price_label.description: What the price covers, e.g. per person or per group

category.description: Activity type, e.g. guidedTour, ticket, transfer

duration.description: Duration label as shown by the site

location.description: Place label shown on the card

position.description: 1-based rank: the site's popularity order first, then the remaining activities by ascending price

total.description: Equals data.total (the site's own count) when data.complete is true

get.summary: Tour & activity listings for a GetYourGuide location slug (e.g. venice-l35), each with price, rating, next availability date and destination.
get.description:
Tour & activity listings for a GetYourGuide location slug (e.g. venice-l35), each with price, rating, next availability date and destination.

Each successful request uses 10 credits.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: GetYourGuide place slug in the {city}-l{id} form (from /catalog or an activity URL).

parameters.name: limit

parameters.name: offset

get.summary: Full detail for one activity by numeric id (e.g. 6851): title, description, images, price, rating, review count and sample reviews.
get.description:
Full detail for one activity by numeric id (e.g. 6851): title, description, images, price, rating, review count and sample reviews.

parameters.description: Numeric activity id (the …-t<id> in an activity URL).

description.example: Enjoy a boat tour on the Grand Canal of Venice...

get.summary: Enumerate all activity URLs from a GetYourGuide activity sitemap file (?index, ~5000 each); each entry has the activity id and location slug.
get.description:
Enumerate all activity URLs from a GetYourGuide activity sitemap file (?index, ~5000 each); each entry has the activity id and location slug.

Each successful request uses 1 credit for every 5000 rows it returns (at least 1 credit).

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Which activity sitemap file to read (0-based).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max items per page (default 100, max 5000).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Items to skip for pagination.

get.summary: Resolve a location's tour/activity listings and optionally enrich the top N with full detail (description, images, reviews) in one call.
get.description:
Resolve a location's tour/activity listings and optionally enrich the top N with full detail (description, images, reviews) in one call.

Each successful request uses 10 credits.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: GetYourGuide place slug, e.g. venice-l35.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: When true, enrich the top `enrich` listings with detail (description, images, reviews).

parameters.name: enrich
parameters.description: How many top listings to enrich when detail=true (1-5).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max items per page (default 50, max 200).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Items to skip for pagination.

title.example: Venice: St. Mark's Basilica, Doge's Palace & Bridge of Sighs

detail.description: Present when detail=true (top N only); null on a per-item enrichment failure.

text.example: Our guide was brilliant and answered any questions put to her. Well worth it.

get.summary: Explore a location: every activity, optional detail for the top N
get.description:
Every tour/activity GetYourGuide lists for a location (all pages, pagination.total = the site's count), optionally with full detail (description, images, reviews) for the top N, in one call.

Each successful request uses 10 credits for every 24 rows it returns (at least 10 credits).

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: GetYourGuide place slug, e.g. venice-l35.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: When true, enrich the top `enrich` activities with detail (description, images, reviews).

parameters.name: enrich
parameters.description: How many top activities to enrich when detail=true (1-5).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max activities per page (default 50, max 1000). Every page of the location is fetched once and cached, so any limit/offset is served from the same full list.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Activities to skip. Works up to pagination.total (the site's full count), not just the first page.

enrich.description: How many activities were enriched (0 when detail=false)

total.description: The site's own count of activities for the location

complete.description: True when every activity the site counts was collected (false only if a very large location ran out of time; the list is then a subset)

title.example: Venice: Marco Polo Airport Water Taxi Transfer

abstract.example: Make your arrival in Venice unforgettable with a water taxi transfer to your hotel or the nearest accessible point from Venice Airport.
abstract.description: Short summary shown on the listing card

price_label.description: What the price covers, e.g. per person or per group

category.description: Activity type, e.g. guidedTour, ticket, transfer

duration.description: Duration label as shown by the site

location.description: Place label shown on the card

position.description: 1-based rank: the site's popularity order first, then the remaining activities by ascending price

get.description:
Find GetYourGuide places (cities, regions, countries, attractions) by name: id, name, type, descriptor (e.g. 'City in Italy') and the place slug (e.g. venice-l35) that /activities, /activities-v2, /explore and /search take.

Each successful request uses 10 credits.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Name of a city, region, country or attraction (any case, accents optional).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max places to return (the site suggests up to 20).

slug.description: The value every location param of this API takes

get.summary: Search tours & activities with the site's filters
get.description:
Search GetYourGuide tours & activities by free text and/or place, with the site's filters (dates, price range, duration, minimum rating, languages, start time, features, categories, departure place) and sort orders. 24 results per page; data.total is the site's own count.

Each successful request uses 10 credits for every 24 rows it returns (at least 10 credits).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free text, as typed in the site's search box (an activity, attraction or place). q, location or both are required.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Limit to one place: a place slug from /locations (venice-l35) or its numeric id (35).

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Only activities available on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Alone, it searches that one day.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Last day of the date range (YYYY-MM-DD); needs date_from.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Lowest starting price, in EUR.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Highest starting price, in EUR.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order of the results. With q, the text match is weighed in too.

parameters.name: languages
parameters.description: Guide/audio languages, comma separated ISO codes (en, de, fr, es, it, ...): activities offered in any of them.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Durations, comma separated: 0-3h, 3-5h, 5-7h, full-day, 2-days, 3-days, 4-days, 5-days-plus.

parameters.name: min_rating
parameters.description: Minimum average rating.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Start times, comma separated: morning (before 12 PM), afternoon (12-5 PM), evening (after 5 PM).

parameters.name: features
parameters.description: Features, comma separated: private, small-group, skip-the-line, wheelchair-accessible, hotel-pickup, originals.

parameters.name: categories
parameters.description: Category ids, comma separated: the tc<n> in a category page address (gondola-tours-tc264 -> tc-264).

parameters.name: departs_from
parameters.description: Departure places, comma separated slugs or ids from /locations.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page of the site's results, 24 per page (1 to 34; the site serves no pages past about 34). data.total is the full count; narrow the query with filters to reach more rows.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows of this page to return (default 50: the whole 24-row page).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows of this page to skip.

total.description: The site's own count of results for this query

has_more.description: Another page can be requested with page+1

title.example: Venice: Grand Canal Gondola Ride with App Commentary

abstract.example: Make your arrival in Venice unforgettable with a water taxi transfer to your hotel or the nearest accessible point from Venice Airport.
abstract.description: Short summary shown on the listing card

price_label.description: What the price covers, e.g. per person or per group

category.description: Activity type, e.g. guidedTour, ticket, transfer

duration.description: Duration label as shown by the site

location.description: Place label shown on the card

position.description: Rank in the site's order across pages (page 2 starts at 25)

total.description: Rows in this page of the site's results (use page for more)

message.description: What went wrong, in a sentence.

BadRequest.description: A parameter is missing or cannot be used.

Unauthorized.description: No API key was sent, or the key is invalid or revoked (`missing_api_key`, `invalid_api_key`).

example.message: Provide an API key via the Authorization: Bearer <key> header.

CreditLimitReached.description: The plan's credits for this period are used up.

example.message: You've used all 1,000 credits in your Free plan for this period. Upgrade your plan for a higher allotment.

AccountSuspended.description: The account that owns the key is suspended.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests for this key. Wait the number of seconds in `Retry-After`.

example.message: Rate limit exceeded for this API key.

UpstreamFailed.description: The source site could not be read this time. Retrying later usually works.

example.message: The upstream source could not be fetched
